shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat rectangular stone panel
horizontal register bands dividing the surface
rows of repeated small motifs along a band
justification: Both show shallow relief on a flat panel with horizontal banding and, in each, a bird shown in profile with a long beak, but that is about as far as it goes. A depicts an abstract writing-like scheme of repeated chevron and stroke signs in vertical columns around an oval enclosure containing signs, while B depicts a figural scene of naturalistically posed quadrupeds, a bird and other creatures arranged freely in registers beneath a row of arch-like motifs; the organising logic (script-like repetition vs animal scene) is quite different.
